fact: Grinta Ironhead pulls the party aside privately as they leave Clan Ironhead.

subject: Grinta intervention

fact: Grinta Ironhead introduces herself as the granddaughter of Thangus.
source_quote: "my name is Grinta Ironhead."

fact: Grinta Ironhead acknowledges that the city is a political tinderbox.

fact: Clan Ironhead has suffered greatly under the Deepking's trade monopoly.

subject: Clan Ironhead

fact: Grinta Ironhead knows there is something going on in the Whorlstone Caverns.

subject: Grinta Ironhead

fact: Grinta Ironhead offers the party favorable trade terms from Clan Ironhead if the Deepking were unseated.
source_quote: Grinta offers the party a lucrative merchant deal: if the Deepking were unseated, Clan Ironhead — which would become the premier clan — would offer favorable trade terms to those who helped bring about his departure.
subject: Clan Ironhead offer

fact: Grinta Ironhead states that Clan Ironhead would rise to become the premier clan if the Deepking were unseated.
source_quote: Clan Ironhead — which would rise to become the premier clan
subject: Clan Ironhead status prediction

fact: The assistance required by Clan Ironhead is indirect, described as a discount on any goods.
source_quote: The help would be "Not directly": in effect, a discount on any goods.
subject: Nature of assistance

fact: Grinta states Clan Ironhead would be free to do orders advantageous to those present when the Deepking disappeared.
source_quote: "Clan Ironhead would be free to do orders that were advantageous to those who happened to be around when the Deepking disappeared."
subject: Trade advantage clause

fact: Thorin suggests to Clan Ironhead that they stay underground and start a trade network.
source_quote: Thorin: "have you guys considered maybe we should just stay down here and start a trade network?"
subject: Thorin alternative proposal
